cases.ticket_text: What's the difference between the chunking options when I upload a document to my knowledge base? I see General, Parent-Child, and Q&A and I don't know which to pick. -- Felix
cases.baseline_assistant_answer: Hi Felix, here's the quick breakdown: General splits your document into fixed-size segments with some overlap -- good as a default for most content. Parent-Child embeds a smaller child chunk for matching but returns its larger parent chunk to the model, which helps when you want tight retrieval matches but fuller context in the answer. Q&A auto-generates question/answer pairs from your source text, which works well for FAQ-style documents. For a general product manual like yours, I'd start with General chunking and switch to Parent-Child if you notice answers feel like they're missing surrounding context.
